You are building the AGENCY DASHBOARD for a Next.js 16 clone of naano.com. Repo: /Users/raju/work/assignment-8x.

STEP 1 — Read /Users/raju/work/assignment-8x/docs/AGENT_KIT.md IN FULL and obey shared components, conventions, data model, and HARD RULES (don't modify shared files/libs; don't run npm install/dev/build; create new files only; @/ = src/). The agency app layout (src/app/agency/layout.tsx) already wraps your pages in DashboardShell and enforces auth via requireAgency(). Inside pages call `const { agency } = await requireAgency()` to get the current AgencyProfile (includes clientWorkspaces). ALWAYS scope queries to `agency.id` and verify ownership on mutations (workspace.agencyProfileId === agency.id; managed creator.managedByAgencyId === agency.id — else not-found).

Naano agencies come in two types (agency.type): BRAND_AGENCY ("I manage campaigns for companies" → per-client workspaces with budgets) and CREATOR_AGENCY ("I represent creators" → a managed roster; creators have no logins). Your UI should adapt to agency.type.

YOUR ASSIGNED FILES (create only these; new files only):
- src/app/agency/page.tsx — Portfolio overview (adapts to type).
- src/app/agency/clients/page.tsx — Brand-agency client workspaces (create workspace, allocate budget, list campaigns per client). For a CREATOR_AGENCY, show a friendly "This section is for brand agencies" note with a link to /agency/roster.
- src/app/agency/roster/page.tsx — Creator-agency roster management (list managed creators, add creator, CSV import, edit rate). For a BRAND_AGENCY, show a friendly note linking to /agency/clients.
- src/app/actions/agency.ts — server actions ("use server").
- Client components under src/components/agency/ as needed (e.g., CSV import form, add-creator form).

PAGES:
PORTFOLIO (/agency/page.tsx): PageHeader with agency name + a type Badge. 
  - BRAND_AGENCY: KPI cards (client workspaces count, total allocated budget, total campaigns across clients). List client workspaces as cards (clientName, budget, #campaigns) linking to /agency/clients. 
  - CREATOR_AGENCY: KPI cards (roster size, total followers reach across roster, avg price/post). Roster preview grid linking to /agency/roster.
CLIENTS (/agency/clients): (brand agency) list existing AgencyClientWorkspaces (agency.clientWorkspaces) with clientName, budget, and campaigns (query Campaign where agencyClientWorkspaceId in the agency's workspace ids). A "New client workspace" form (client component) → server action createClientWorkspace(clientName, budget). Per-workspace: an "allocate/update budget" inline form → updateClientBudget(workspaceId, budget). Show each workspace's campaigns list if any. Keep CRUD minimal but working. Enforce ownership.
ROSTER (/agency/roster): (creator agency) list CreatorProfiles where managedByAgencyId === agency.id, showing avatar, name, headline, followers, engagement, price/post, available. An "Add creator" form → server action addManagedCreator (name/displayName, headline, followers, pricePerPost, verticals; defaults for required fields incl audienceByFunction:{}, audienceBySeniority:{}, bio:"", location:"", medianReach:0, engagementRate:0, avgReactions:0, avgComments:0). A "Bulk import (CSV)" form: a textarea where the user pastes CSV with headers like `name,headline,followers,pricePerPost,verticals` → server action importRosterCsv parses rows (robust: skip blank/invalid rows, cap number of rows, validate types) and creates managed CreatorProfiles under this agency. Show a result summary (created/skipped). Each roster creator has an inline "edit rate" → updateManagedCreator(creatorId, {pricePerPost, available}). Emphasize "Your creators don't need individual Naano accounts."

SERVER ACTIONS (src/app/actions/agency.ts): "use server"; createClientWorkspace, updateClientBudget, addManagedCreator, importRosterCsv, updateManagedCreator. All validate inputs with zod, verify ownership against the current agency (requireAgency), use explicit field DTOs (no body spreading), cap CSV rows (e.g. max 200) and validate each field, and revalidatePath. Never trust client-supplied ids for ownership.

QUALITY: polished, responsive, on-brand, good empty states, adapt to agency.type. Use PageHeader on each page. All must typecheck — run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix errors in YOUR files (ignore errors from files other agents haven't created yet). 

Return a concise report of files created + the actions implemented.
